fusions.name: Host to Host
fusions.desc: Flicks a burr off the tines into the first enemy it meets, dealing 11 damage and making it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on it then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Combed Out
fusions.desc: Combs through a target carrying one of your afflictions, dealing 8 damage and consuming every affliction on it, adding 1.3 times their remaining damage to the hit.

fusions.name: Off the Haft
fusions.desc: Plants the haft and vaults you 5 tiles forward.

fusions.name: Fresh Host
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions lifts from an enemy, a bolt jumps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
